Set a track figure's colour scales

Source: R/methylationTrack.R
INTERNAL_meth_figure.Rd

The colours live on layout.coloraxis, so changing them needs no redraw.

The Axes tab's lines would otherwise fall on the strips that carry the figure's main axes, so they are moved onto the heatmap here. Passed through fixed.axes, which .sci_finalize_plotly() applies after the shared styling.

Each panel has axes of its own, linked to the others by matches, so a shared axis never makes one panel of several. The first axis on each side goes to the outermost panel, where its labels belong: the columns' under the bottom strips, the samples' beside the right-hand strips. Those are the two axes the Axes tab styles.

The draw step of methylationTrack() and its module. Colours come afterwards, from .meth_apply_scale().

Usage

.meth_apply_scale(
  fig,
  colors = NULL,
  min = NA,
  mid = NA,
  max = NA,
  reverse = FALSE,
  title = "Beta value",
  absent.color = .meth_colors$absent,
  na.color = .meth_colors$na
)

.meth_apply_frame(
  fig,
  font.size = NULL,
  showline = FALSE,
  mirror = FALSE,
  linecolor = NULL,
  linewidth = NULL
)

.meth_empty_cells(betas, absent)

.meth_hover(q, index, y, ny)

.meth_axis_numbers(panels)

.meth_axis_ref(side, number)

.meth_axis_name(side, number)

.meth_add_transcripts(
  fig,
  model,
  to_x,
  xaxis,
  yaxis,
  labels = TRUE,
  font.size = 8,
  exon.color = .meth_colors$exon,
  cds.color = .meth_colors$cds,
  intron.color = .meth_colors$intron
)

.meth_add_dendrogram(fig, trees, rows, xaxis, yaxis)

.meth_add_ideogram(fig, bands, region, xaxis, yaxis)

.meth_axes(
  panels,
  numbers,
  n,
  ny,
  rows,
  sample.names,
  left,
  right,
  bottom,
  column.labels,
  ticks,
  txn.rows,
  height,
  chrom.end
)

.meth_figure(
  q,
  group.by = NULL,
  group.gap = 1,
  cluster.samples = FALSE,
  dist.method = "euclidean",
  hclust.method = "ward.D2",
  show.dendrogram = TRUE,
  anno.left = NULL,
  anno.right = NULL,
  anno.colors = NULL,
  anno.low = .meth_colors$anno.low,
  anno.high = .meth_colors$anno.high,
  show.sample.names = TRUE,
  txn.view = "full",
  txn.types = "protein_coding",
  txn.labels = TRUE,
  txn.font.size = 8,
  exon.color = .meth_colors$exon,
  cds.color = .meth_colors$cds,
  intron.color = .meth_colors$intron,
  show.cytoband = TRUE,
  show.map.lines = TRUE,
  show.coverage = TRUE,
  cpg.tracks = NULL,
  cpg.labels = "none"
)

Arguments

fig

The figure so far.

colors, min, mid, max, reverse

Passed to VizModules::resolve_colorscale().

title

The colorbar's title.

absent.color, na.color

Colours of the two kinds of empty cell.

font.size

The labels' size.

showline, mirror, linecolor, linewidth

The Axes tab's axis lines.

betas, absent

Matrices with rows for samples, as plotted.

q

A query, from .meth_query().

index

The plotted order of the samples.

y

Each plotted sample's heatmap row.

ny

The heatmap's rows.

panels

The panel domains, from .meth_domains().

side

"x" or "y".

number

The axis number.

model

The transcripts, from .meth_txn_model().

to_x

A function from genomic position to the x axis.

xaxis, yaxis

The panel's axis references.

labels

Logical; label the transcripts.

exon.color, cds.color, intron.color

See methylationTrack().

trees

The trees from .meth_order().

rows

Each plotted sample's heatmap row.

bands

The chromosome's cytobands.

region

A region, from .meth_region().

numbers

The axis numbers, from .meth_axis_numbers().

n

The heatmap's columns.

sample.names

Sample names, or NULL to leave them off.

left, right

The strips' column names.

bottom

The bottom strips' row names.

column.labels

The heatmap's column labels, or NULL.

ticks

Genomic position ticks, a list of at and label, or NULL.

txn.rows

The transcript rows.

height

The tallest dendrogram.

chrom.end

The length of the chromosome.

group.by, group.gap, cluster.samples, dist.method, hclust.method

See methylationTrack().

show.dendrogram, anno.left, anno.right, anno.colors, anno.low, anno.high

See methylationTrack().

show.sample.names, txn.view, txn.types, txn.labels, txn.font.size

See methylationTrack().

show.cytoband, show.map.lines, show.coverage, cpg.tracks, cpg.labels

See methylationTrack().

Value

The figure.

The figure.

A matrix: 1 where the array lacks the CpG, 2 for a value that is missing, and NA over a value.

A list of values and empty, character matrices over the heatmap's cells, or NULL for a heatmap too large to carry them (see .meth_hover_limit).

A named list of x and y axis numbers per panel.

A string such as "x2", or "xaxis2".

The figure.

The figure.

The figure.

A named list of axes for plotly::layout().

A built plotly figure, with attributes table, fixed.axes, heat.axes and beta.range.
